plan.notes: NOTE: Dallas College's catalog site (catalog.dallascollege.edu) returned HTTP 403 to the research fetcher, so the complete semester-by-semester course sequence was taken from the official Guided Pathways (GPS) page, which the page itself labels 'Catalog Year 2026-2027'. The GPS page states: 'This is not an official degree plan. See the catalog for official degree requirements.' Page notes: * Music majors should take these courses in their first or second semester to avoid delays in degree completion. ** MUAP and MUEN courses are needed for transfer. Check transfer guides and with your success coach for more information. *** There are several options to fulfill this requirement. See your success coach for a specific list.
